title: The Heartbeat of Watts: 41st Annual Day of the Drum Festival
description:
The 41st Annual Watts Towers Day of the Drum Festival brought rhythm, culture, and community together at the Watts Towers Arts Center campus.

Presented by the City of Los Angeles Department of Cultural Affairs, the festival celebrates the powerful role drumming plays across cultures and generations. Featuring acoustic drumming and traditions from across the African diaspora, the event creates opportunities to learn about history, instruments, cultural traditions, and the shared connection created through music.

The festival also highlights the importance of preserving drum culture while expanding access to arts, music, museum, and educational experiences in the Watts community.

Visit the Watts Towers Arts Center campus to experience its rich cultural history, exhibitions, programs, and community arts offerings.
